prompt: Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa circuit for a balanced oracle on a 3-bit input x (qubits 0, 1, 2) with ancilla qubit 3, where the oracle is f(x) = XOR of x_i over every bit position i where bit i of the integer secret=5 is set (i.e. f(x) = sum over i of ((secret >> i) & 1) * x_i, mod 2) — this defines the function (secret=5=0b101 selects bits 0 and 2, i.e. f(x) = x0 XOR x2), but stated via the formula/parameter instead of the already-expanded bit list. Steps: initialize the ancilla (qubit 3) to |1> with an X gate, apply Hadamard to all 4 qubits, apply the oracle as CNOT(control=qubit i, target=qubit 3) for every input qubit i whose corresponding bit of secret=5 is set, then apply Hadamard to qubits 0, 1, 2 only (not the ancilla). Return the resulting 4-qubit state; no measurement.
